name: p1_g07_2
notes: P267 FC3 (batch p1-G07-2): hash-type identification only - no cracking and no plaintext lookup. hashes.com and crackstation.net are core seed entries; ntlm.pw (an NTLM plaintext lookup service named by the final condition) is added here so the P327 lint (LINT-08) refuses it everywhere.
